note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 2 June 1927. The Larne Times nomination-day report lists all 16 district electoral divisions: contests in Ardclinis and Cairncastle; Islandmagee South left with one nominee after the retiring member withdrew; 11 other divisions with a single nominee; no nominations for Ballycorr and Templecorran, whose retiring members were deemed re-elected. The first meeting of the new council (LT 11 June 1927) names sixteen elected members. Two nominations (retiring member H. J. S. Milliken and T. H. Brown); Milliken withdrew and Brown was declared elected (LT 14 May 1927 p2). Printed 'Browne' in the first-meeting list. Returned unopposed.
